title: Jayden Daniels was a limited participant in practice again on Thursday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels was a limited participant in practice again on Thursday
sources.description: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels said on Thursday that he's taking things day by day in his return from a dislocated left elbow and his status on the team's injury report remained the same as it was on Wednesday.
